Compared with chlorambucil and prednisone, cladribine and pred- nisone gave higher response rates but increased toxicity, and overall survival was not statistically different.15 Pento- statin has also been investigated.1 Pentostatin with cyclo- phosphamide was well-tolerated and produced good over- all response rates in a small group of patients refractory to fludarabine.7,12 In patients who fail treatment with conventional therapy, the monoclonal antibodies alemtuzumab and rituximab have produced encouraging results.3,6,12,16-18 Combina- tions of these antibodies with other drugs have been stud- ied in CLL,4,5,7,8,19 and the use of rituximab with fludarab- ine especially has shown marked clinical efficacy.6,7,9,20 Alemtuzumab may be used as first-line therapy in patients with certain cytogenetic abnormalities associated with
